name: TextArea
description: A text field for more than one line, such as a message. It looks like a text input, starts at the number of rows set in its markup, and people can drag it taller. Labels and help text work the same as for a text input.

size.description: The text area's size. With none chosen, it's the default size: 6 / 12px padding, 18px text and 6px corners.

small.description: A small text area: 4 / 8px padding, 15.75px text and 4px corners.

font.size.$description: Small text area text size: 15.75px, seven eighths of the 18px body text.

large.description: A large text area: 8 / 16px padding, text from 20.25px up to 22.5px, and 8px corners.

font.size.$description: Large text area text size below the xl breakpoint (1200px): 20.25px plus 0.1875% of the screen width, so it grows to 22.5px at 1200px.
Large text area text size from the xl breakpoint (1200px) up: 22.5px.

line-height.$description: Text area text line height: 28px on 18px text.

transition.duration.$description: How long the text area's border and focus ring take to change. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the text area's border and focus ring changes. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

placeholder.opacity.$description: Text area placeholder opacity, so it reads as lighter than typed text.
